items.summary: Update the Leaderboard tab (All-Time Rankings table) to remove the "Score" stat entirely (header and row values) so it is not displayed anywhere in the leaderboard table UI.
Restore the "Win %" statistic in the all-time leaderboard table, calculated from all-time data only (wins / totalGames), and display it as a dedicated column for each player.

Restore the "Streak" statistic in the all-time leaderboard table and display it as a dedicated column for each player, using the existing all-time streak value returned by the backend leaderboard API.

Ensure the backend leaderboard API continues to provide all-time stats needed for the restored columns (wins, losses, totalGames, streak) and that leaderboard updates after recording/removing wins/losses reflect these fields without requiring weekly/monthly logic.
